description: You can follow a container-backed stack with guarded reads and removals.

steps.description: Stack takes an element type and defaults its storage to vector<T>. push moves its value into the storage's back.
pop and top check empty before accessing the last element. top returns a const reference, while empty and size delegate to storage.

steps.question: What becomes the integer stack's top after popping 3?

steps.description: The first two displayed values are 3 and 2, before and after pop.
The string stack uses the same template interface. Its last pushed value, world, is the final displayed top.

title: Use one stack template for two types
